english.title: Use / lend / allowed use of a notice of entry / certificate of registration under pharmacy order for fraudulent purposes
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[used]_
(B)_[lent to a person]_
(C)_[allowed to be used by a person]_

(D)_[a notice of entry]_
(E)_[a certificate of registration]_

in respect of **(..SPECIFY NAME..),

(G)_[a pharmacist]_
(H)_[a pharmaceutical chemist]_

english.legislation: Contrary to article 38(7)(a) and (9) of the Pharmacy Order 2010.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex, see Article 38(10)Note
Article 38(10) states: Proceedings for an offence under this article may be begun at any time within the period of 6 months beginning with the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Council to justify a prosecution came to the Council's knowledge; but no proceedings may be begun after the expiry of the period of two years beginning with the date of the commission of the offence.
